meta.method_note: Expanded 2026-10-01 from 95 to 202 corridors drawn from USGS Mineral Industry Surveys, UN Comtrade / BACI annual tables, IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook corridor charts, ICSG World Copper Factbook, Cobalt Institute market reports, World Silver Survey, Johnson Matthey PGM Market Report, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence LFP tracker, and Adamas Intelligence NdFeB magnet tracker. Every corridor is at the "known to occur in meaningful volume" bar; weights remain on the 1-5 relative scale until the BACI refresh.

policies.title: Nickel ore export ban
policies.detail: Unprocessed ore exports banned from January 2020, pulling smelting onshore.

policies.title: Raw lithium ore export ban
policies.detail: Ban on unprocessed lithium ore since December 2022, with a planned ban on concentrate exports. Check the effective date.

policies.title: Ban on unprocessed lithium exports
policies.detail: Unprocessed lithium and some other critical minerals may not be exported since 2023.

policies.title: Graphite export licensing
policies.detail: Licences required for several graphite products since December 2023.

policies.title: Rare earth and magnet export controls
policies.detail: Licensing for medium and heavy rare earths and magnets from April 2025, extended later in the year. Check which measures are in force.

policies.title: Controls on lithium processing and LFP technology
policies.detail: Technology export restrictions covering lithium refining and LFP cathode know-how.

policies.title: National Lithium Strategy
policies.detail: State majority participation in strategic salt flats through public-private partnerships.

policies.title: EU Critical Raw Materials Act
policies.detail: 2030 benchmarks: 10% extraction, 40% processing, 25% recycling, and no more than 65% from a single third country per stage.

policies.title: DRC-Zambia battery value chain agreement
policies.detail: Cooperation agreement and a pre-feasibility study for a cross-border battery and EV special economic zone.

policies.title: LFP technology and phosphate processing export controls
policies.detail: Export licensing on high-purity phosphate chemicals and LFP cathode manufacturing know-how introduced 2023, tightened 2025. Verify current status.

policies.title: OCP state ownership and integrated processing strategy
policies.detail: State-owned OCP holds Morocco phosphate reserves and is expanding downstream into purified phosphoric acid and LFP precursors, targeting integrated value capture.
